_comment: Maintainer-tested results. Community reports (GitHub issues labelled 'compatibility') are merged in docs/data/reports.json by .github/workflows/compat-data.yml.

mods.name: AgriCraft
mods.notes: Crops, greenhouses in modern villages and rendering verified.

mods.name: Applied Energistics 2
mods.notes: Loads, 16 GUIs open, blocks and items render. Some cable/part inventory icons are blank.

mods.name: BiblioCraft
mods.notes: Tile-entity rendered furniture, inventory icons and GUIs verified.

mods.name: Botania
mods.notes: Loads with the Baubles bridge (Curios installed): 771 items, 307 blocks and 19 entity types register and self-test. GUIs and gameplay not verified yet.

mods.name: BuildCraft
mods.notes: Loads, 6 GUIs open; some GUIs depended on icon providers that were fixed after the last full sweep.

mods.name: EnderIO
mods.notes: Fails during init: EnderCore's Techne model loader (TechneModel) is not implemented yet.

mods.name: Forestry
mods.notes: Loads after the BlockCocoa constructor fix; 45 blocks and 533 items register. GUIs and genetics gameplay not verified yet.

mods.name: IndustrialCraft 2
mods.notes: Loads, 72 screens open. Long-running machine behaviour not verified.

mods.name: Mystcraft
mods.notes: Loads, 6 GUIs open. Writing desk screen draws incorrectly.

mods.name: RFTools
mods.notes: 42 GUIs open, including logic and monitor blocks.

mods.name: Thaumcraft
mods.notes: Arcane Workbench, Arcane Bore and other GUIs, Outer Lands dimension and world generation verified.

mods.name: Thermal Expansion
mods.notes: Machine GUIs open, RF gauge hover tooltips work.

mods.name: Tinkers' Construct
mods.notes: Loads, tables and smeltery render, the manual opens. No bridge to a modern Tinkers' Construct yet; manual item icons draw black.

mods.name: Twilight Forest
mods.notes: Portal, dimension generation, entities and loot verified.

mods.name: Witchery
mods.notes: Loads, village walls and towers generate. The Dream World teleport returns the player to the overworld.
